title: Single op (forward): feed_forward.routed_experts: index_put_
bitwise_notes: order-sensitive data movement (index_put_): accumulation / selection order must match eager exactly.
blockers: aten.index_put(_) under deterministic mode runs a sort-based path (memset/memcpy of the full destination); accumulate=True needs a deterministic segmented reduction. If the indices are a permutation (from sort/argsort), there are no duplicates and a gather/scatter is order-free. a dimension is data-dependent (unbacked SymInts): kernels need dynamic shapes.
